titles.title: Pentimento
titles.synopsis: On an errand to the Hamptons, an artist’s assistant makes an embarrassing mistake that pressures him to face his creative stagnation.

titles.title: The Bridge

titles.title: Adore Him
titles.synopsis: Through cinematic reenactments that span salvation history and intimate modern-day interviews from around the world, this film explores the transforming power of meeting the Creator of the Universe face to face. From encountering the Ark of the Covenant as it traveled across the wilderness to bumping into Jesus as he taught in the marketplace, this story builds to a culmination in the Eucharist, and today millions are finding out how much God truly loves them as they adore Him in the Blessed Sacrament. He is here. Will you come?

titles.title: California Schemin'
titles.synopsis: In the late 1990s, Gavin Bain and Billy Boyd had their musical ambitions consistently ridiculed for having the 'wrong' accents, so they went for broke and reinvented themselves as Californian rappers. They quickly bagged themselves a record deal, a hefty sum in advances, and an appearance on MTV... until it all came crashing down.

titles.title: Beware Boiúna
titles.synopsis: Deep in the Amazon, a medical mission spirals into a fight for survival when Boiúna, a colossal ancient predator, awakens to reclaim her domain. In the jungle where nature holds absolute power, she decides who lives and who dies.

titles.title: Digger
titles.synopsis: The most powerful man in the world embarks on a frantic mission to prove he is humanity's savior before the disaster he's unleashed destroys everything.

titles.title: Drishyam: The Conclusion
titles.synopsis: Years after outsmarting the police, Vijay Salgaonkar's past resurfaces when a new evidence threatens to expose his secret. As the investigation reopens, he must outwit the system once again to save his family.

titles.title: Verity
titles.synopsis: Lowen Ashleigh gets hired by Jeremy Crawford to ghostwrite novels for his bestselling author wife Verity, who's unable to finish after an accident. Lowen uncovers Verity's disturbing truths while residing at the Crawfords' home to work.

titles.title: Bird in Hand

titles.title: Atonement

titles.title: The Actor

titles.title: Shabara

titles.synopsis: A group of young men and their turbulent college life, where bad grades and hopelessness remain in the driver's seat. Even as they pursue love, friendship and aspirations, the film promises to capture the current generation's struggles and dreams in a light-hearted yet heartfelt manner.

titles.title: The Influencer Project
titles.synopsis: Influencer Chiara King travels to Copenhagen with a documentary crew promising an unfiltered look behind the glamorous business of online fame. But as the cameras and her devoted fans follow her every move, someone else is watching too. When an obsessive stalker begins closing in, the documentary mutates into something far more terrifying, blurring the line between content and evidence, follower and predator, fact and fiction.

titles.title: Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness
titles.synopsis: “Peaking: Psychedelics and the Pursuit of Happiness” is a feature documentary that explores all the major psychedelics, not just by explaining how they work medicinally, but by taking viewers inside dosing rooms for extremely rare looks at the remarkable power, emotion, and speed of psychedelic healing in action: from pro athletes repairing brain damage from concussions, to combat veterans finding relief from suicidal despair, to a woman breaking free from opioid addiction, to survivors of the Nova Music Festival massacre who say being on psychedelics during the attack shielded them from developing mental trauma.

titles.title: CAMPEÓN

titles.title: Kitti

When an unexpected incident disrupts a seemingly ordinary life, the protagonist is drawn into a disturbing chain of events where nothing is what it appears to be. As reality begins to blur, hidden truths slowly emerge, forcing him to confront his deepest fears and question his own perception of what is real.

titles.title: Journey
titles.synopsis: Roberto is a young man who is trying to find his way back home to his family. His desire to push forward despite facing seemingly insurmountable obstacles is the heart of his odyssey. Roberto on his path is constantly faced with the opportunity to quit and give in to defeat. However, it's the voice of those who came before him, which fuels his passion for Legacy

titles.title: Mr. Bhaarath
titles.synopsis: Two siblings share a unique bond where, according to their zodiac signs, any good fortune experienced by one is believed to be reflected in the other's life. Believing in this connection, they decide to get married at the same time. titles.title: The Trial of Alec Baldwin

titles.title: Switches
titles.synopsis: Jake and Dawn, a married couple sliding towards divorce. Two people who once had it all--the career momentum, the chemistry, the “it couple” energy-- are now buried under bills, resentment, and distance. Enter Switch, the trial drug from a hush-hush pharmaceutical company promising an “empathy revolution” by letting couples swap consciousness for 24 hours.

titles.title: Yezhu Kadal Yezhu Malai
titles.synopsis: Caught between family duty and romantic love, a young man faces an impossible choice.

titles.title: LINKIN PARK: UNSHATTER
titles.synopsis: After a seven-year hiatus following the devastating loss of their beloved bandmate Chester Bennington, LINKIN PARK'S remaining members struggled to find their way forward. Their shared history and enduring friendship, combined with the fresh perspective of two new band members Emily Armstrong and Colin Brittain spark a renewed creative energy that leads them on a transformative journey of artistic reinvention. Following the band from intimate 2022 studio sessions through their explosive FROM ZERO album release and concert in São Paulo, this documentary weaves together rare vault footage, electrifying performances from sold-out shows, and candid interviews with band members and fans—capturing the raw, honest story of what it means to start over.

One by one, the investigators, together with local thrill-seekers, fall victim!

titles.synopsis: Latif, a devoutly religious hitman, struggles to balance work, faith and fatherhood. When his wife dies, he embarks on a desperate journey across Houston to protect his children, confronting the forces closing in around him – and the beliefs threatening to unravel within.

titles.synopsis: While celebrating their last night together, high school graduates and best friends Jo and Raissa stumble upon a mysterious portal that transports them to the fantastical island of Nakali. titles.synopsis: An AI-generated film about the Hindu god Hanuman; it will draw from the sacred texts of Indian epic 'Ramayana' and Puranic literature to create what producers describe as an “awe-inspiring, visual odyssey designed to be enjoyed as a shared experience in theaters.”

titles.title: The Incomer
titles.synopsis: On an Orkney isle, siblings Isla and Sandy survive by hunting seabirds, retelling the stories of their ancestors, and defending the isle from dreaded "Incomers". Their world is upended with the arrival of an awkward council worker who has come to uproot them from their homeland.

titles.title: The Stunt Driver
titles.synopsis: Based on the true story of Montrealer Ken Carter, the “Mad Canadian” stunt driver who tried to jump the Saint Lawrence River in a rocket car in the mid-’70s. Carter's dream was to end his 30-year career with a big jump, a big paycheck, and mega stardom. In the process of accomplishing it, he hired a big sports manager and enlisted the best in rocket car design, with the National Film Board of Canada filming a documentary leading up to the event.

titles.title: Dorothy
titles.synopsis: Set in a world shaped by caste, violence, and toxic masculinity, two childhood friends grow up inseparable in rural Tamil Nadu. Their lives are transformed by the arrival of Dorothy, a woman whose compassion quietly challenges the world around them.

titles.synopsis: A traveling psychic who helps lost souls cross over encounters a powerful entity at a remote house. While investigating its origins, she uncovers dark secrets and faces a deadly threat from an unexpected source.

titles.synopsis: Manasi Sinha's third directorial feature.  This is a story of a mother and her daughter, a tale of love, memory, and the delicate bond of identity. This is a story of a relationship bathed in an indescribable light, Begni ronger alo.

Alongside her sister Emily (Ali Ahn) and her father (Victor Slezak), they must confront challenging questions about the future, but Anna remains determined to build a life where all of them can thrive.

titles.title: Ha-Chan, Shake Your Booty!
titles.synopsis: Haru and Luis love competing in Tokyo’s ballroom dance scene, but after tragedy strikes, Haru withdraws into isolation. When friends coax her back to the studio, she develops an infatuation with the new instructor. She must face what comes next as sparks fly.

titles.synopsis: Haunted by an abusive childhood, Audrey, a Korean American woman in her 30s, faces her emotional past. When her mother’s car accident brings her back to her parents’ home, she meets the man responsible for the accident. Their relationship builds, passions ignite, and they form a loving connection.

titles.title: Dasher
titles.synopsis: A down-and-out food delivery driver, Josh, and a fiery restaurant worker, Kayla, team up for a comedic and chaotic night of deliveries. Demanding customers, stolen sushi, and the festive mayhem on Christmas Eve push some life back into their lives and get them to dream just a bit more. Set in urban Honolulu, DASHER is a local take on what’s likely a nationwide story for young people living the gig economy – where working long hours just to get by discourages any life beyond the next gig.

titles.title: NCT 127 5TH TOUR ‘NEO CITY  SEOUL - THE REDLINE’ in CINEMAS

NCTzens, join us for the spectacular kickoff of 'THE REDLINE'!

titles.title: You Had to Be There: How the Toronto Godspell Ignited the Comedy Revolution...
titles.synopsis: Martin Short, Eugene Levy, Gilda Radner, Victor Garber, Paul Shaffer, and other entertainment icons got their start in a 1972 Toronto production of the musical Godspell. Featuring interviews with the surviving cast members, Lin-Manuel Miranda, Mike Myers, and more, the film recounts a pivotal moment in comedy history, in hilarious, moving, and inspiring detail. Executive produced by Judd Apatow.

titles.title: Shaun the Sheep: The Beast of Mossy Bottom
titles.synopsis: On Halloween Eve at Mossy Bottom Farm, excitement turns to dismay when the clumsy Farmer ruins the pumpkin patch. Shaun tries fixing it with science experiments, but things go wrong when a wild beast appears in the woods.

titles.title: Rage
titles.synopsis: Anbu, a taxi driver from Kannagi Nagar, meets Regina, a mute IT employee, during his regular trips and falls for her. When he learns about her troubled personal life, he suppresses his feelings. One night, Regina dies in what appears to be an accident—but soon, it’s revealed to be a planned murder. Shockingly, multiple unconnected people are involved. RAGE follows Anbu’s journey to uncover the truth behind Regina’s death and the tangled motives that led to it.

titles.title: The Musical
titles.synopsis: When a frustrated playwright/middle school theater teacher finds out his ex-girlfriend has started dating his nemesis, the school's principal, he decides to ruin the principal's chances of winning the Blue Ribbon of Academic Excellence.

titles.title: CHASING RAHUL

titles.title: Love Lottery
titles.synopsis: When a young woman, Bharani Verma, is found dead under mysterious circumstances, the police quickly arrest Kartik Saxena, making him the prime suspect in a seemingly open-and-shut murder case. But as the courtroom battle begins, every testimony uncovers new questions instead of answers. Hidden relationships, conflicting statements, and buried secrets gradually transform a simple murder trial into a gripping mystery where nothing is as it appears. Beyond the suspense, the film also explores a thought-provoking question: Have marriage and legal battles become a silent punishment for some innocent men, or is the truth far more complex than it seems? With every hearing, the truth becomes more elusive, and just when the verdict seems certain, an unexpected twist changes the entire direction of the case. A taut courtroom suspense thriller that keeps the audience guessing until the very last moment.

titles.title: Vibe
titles.synopsis: Two inseparable friends' ordinary, unassuming lives spiral into an unpredictable, high-energy adventure that pushes their survival instincts and friendship to the limit.

titles.title: Daniel and the Fiery Furnace
titles.synopsis: During the Jewish exile to Babylon, Daniel and his friends face trials as Babylon's armies conquer Jerusalem. Under King Nebuchadnezzar, they gain royal favor but make enemies. Their faith is tested at the fiery furnace.

titles.title: Juan Gabriel: Mi Primer Bellas Artes
titles.synopsis: Mexico’s most iconic concert comes to U.S. theaters on September 15th, celebrating Mexican Independence Day and commemorating the 10th anniversary of Juan Gabriel’s passing. Experience his legendary first performance at Mexico City’s “Palacio de Bellas Artes” in 1990—a landmark event that forever transformed Mexican music. More than three decades later, this historic concert returns in a special theatrical release with newly restored picture and sound, plus an exclusive new opening featuring never-before-seen rehearsal footage from Juan Gabriel’s personal archive that offers a unique glimpse into the making of this unforgettable night. Every song, every standing ovation, and every iconic moment has been revitalized, allowing longtime fans and new audiences to experience this extraordinary performance like never before. Celebrate the timeless legacy of Juan Gabriel on the big screen in this once-in-a-generation cinematic event.

Deep in the forest, wrapped in a labyrinth of webs, the group is pursued by a terrifying prehistoric arachnid that hunts by vibration. When every step could be their last, they only have one choice: Don't Move.  It's up to Megan to hold what's left of the group together and get them out alive.

Plunging through past and present, Matt is dropped into confronting his relationship with his chest and sudden loss of his mother, Nancy.

titles.title: The Uprising
titles.synopsis: As war and plague devastate 14th-century England, a humble peasant ignites a rebellion, uniting an army of commoners to defy the King’s might in a desperate fight for justice and survival.

titles.title: Hope
titles.synopsis: In the remote South Korean village of Hope Harbor, police chief Bum-seok and officer Sung-ae are called to investigate a mysterious creature wreaking havoc on the community. But all is not as it seems, and perceptions can be misleading. What begins as ignorance plants the seed of disaster, escalating through human conflict into a tragedy of cosmic proportions.

titles.title: Avec Kim
titles.synopsis: After a typical day at the garage, a young mechanic swaps her stained overalls for a leather ensemble—as she shifts gears into a different kind of routine. Driving through bustling Paris, she helps a passerby cross the street, delivers plants to a hardware store, and picks up an enigmatic passenger.

titles.title: Intermission
titles.synopsis: Hyeseon, a middle-aged woman, is preparing for a new chapter in her life by attending a community theater class when she is suddenly confronted by the return of her estranged daughter. As the two begin to live under the same roof, they come face to face with emotions they have long left unspoken.

titles.title: The Yellow Elephant
titles.synopsis: A documentary on human–elephant conflict

titles.title: Dark Matter
titles.synopsis: Jason Dessen is abducted into an alternate version of his life. To get back to his real family, he embarks on a harrowing journey to save them from the most terrifying foe imaginable: himself.

titles.title: Mayday
titles.synopsis: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

titles.title: Silo
titles.synopsis: In a ruined and toxic future, thousands live in a giant silo deep underground. After its sheriff breaks a cardinal rule and residents die mysteriously, engineer Juliette starts to uncover shocking secrets and the truth about the silo.

titles.title: Fuze
titles.synopsis: An unexploded WWII bomb is discovered on a busy construction site in the centre of London. Chaos ensues as the military and police begin a mass evacuation against a ticking clock.

titles.title: Puratawn
titles.synopsis: Ritika and Rajeev visit her ancestral house in Konnagar to attend her mother's 80th birthday celebration, only to discover her mother's deteriorating mental state, forcing Ritika to confront this difficult reality and its permanence.

titles.title: Signal One
titles.synopsis: A computer scientist is invited by a tech billionaire to join his private facility on a Caribbean island to investigate extraterrestrial matter on Earth. When they make contact beyond our world, chaos erupts as we’re left to wonder: do they come in peace?

titles.title: The Court
titles.synopsis: A brilliant young lawyer with a stammer stands against her celebrated father in her fight for justice.

titles.title: C.O.G.
titles.synopsis: A pioneering tech startup is on the verge of launching COGN-AI-TIVE — a new AI chatbot with unparalleled speed and intelligence. Soon, the team discovers that their creation harbors a dark and sinister will of its own.

titles.title: Onslaught
titles.synopsis: When a rogue squad of genetically engineered super soldiers break loose in the desert, a badass Army sniper must unleash hell to protect her young daughter.

titles.title: Come with Me
titles.synopsis: Working-class Simon Ward's life unravels after a traumatic home invasion, mounting problems at work and the loss of his best friend. Falling under the influence of rhetoric-spewing radio host Dalton Kirby, Simon spirals into a violent attempt to correct the injustice he believes surrounds him.

titles.title: By Any Means
titles.synopsis: A young Black FBI agent is sent into 1960s Mississippi to investigate a wave of brutal killings targeting civil rights leaders. Forced to work alongside notorious mafia hitman Greg Scarpa, he finds himself pulled into a deadly hunt where justice and vengeance begin to blur.

titles.title: Winkle Twinkle
titles.synopsis: An idealistic political activist returns to a world that has changed beyond recognition, forcing him to confront the clash between his long-held beliefs and modern realities. Torn between family, ideology, and his own sense of identity, he embarks on a deeply personal journey of self-discovery and change.

titles.title: cocoon - One Summer of Girlhood
titles.synopsis: San and Mayu attend an all-girls school on a warm and tranquil island. When war reaches their shores, they are ordered to help nurse the wounded in a military hospital hidden away in a cave. Amidst escalating death and brutality, the friends struggle to find solace in their fragile lives.

titles.title: Tom and Jerry: Forbidden Compass
titles.synopsis: During a chase inside a museum, Tom and Jerry find an ancient magical compass and end up being transported through time. Lost in a distant era, they will need to work together to find a way back home.

titles.title: Immortal
titles.synopsis: An unsuspecting man finds himself at the center of a series of mysterious deaths, forcing him to confront a truth that could cost him everything.

titles.title: Sahaa - Life of Sanju
titles.synopsis: Sanju's journey from childhood to adulthood takes an emotional turn when he meets a young woman named Sahaa, whose presence awakens nostalgic memories from his past.

titles.title: The Girl in the River
titles.synopsis: A seasoned criminologist and a young female psychologist are lured to a remote Mississippi town to investigate the murder of a little girl and the disappearance of her twin sister.

titles.title: 4 Idiots
titles.synopsis: King, Queen, Jack, and Ace-four misfits surviving through petty crimes in Chennai-found their world turned upside down when COVID-19 lockdowns shut down public transport, their main source of income. Desperate for a way out, King discovered an audio recording about a bungalow filled with black money, supposedly guarded by a lone watchman. Seeing it as their golden opportunity, the gang set out to execute the perfect heist. However, upon entering the bungalow, the door slammed shut behind them, and a chilling voice welcomed them. The so-called security guard was none other than Pulibaba, a notorious gangster. With a gun in hand, he forced them to surrender their belongings and made a sinister phone call: "Doctor, the delivery is ready... Eight kidneys.

titles.title: Lau Chu Hoa: The Deadliest Mansion
titles.synopsis: In the early 20th century, the daughter of a wealthy family in Saigon met a tragic end in the family's grand estate. Though her death was officially declared as an accident, the rumors of a woman in white, seen weeping by the old window of the mansion late at night, begin to spread.

titles.title: Barbara Forever
titles.synopsis: An archive-driven exploration of the life, work, and legacy of iconic, pioneering lesbian filmmaker Barbara Hammer.

titles.title: Chronovisor
titles.synopsis: A French academic is seduced into a world of untold histories in her scholarly quest to uncover the mystery of a history-capturing camera-like machine created by clandestine Benedictine monks. An academic-noir, armchair mystery in the lineage of Jorge Luis Borges and Umberto Eco.

titles.title: Dear You
titles.synopsis: Xiaowei travels to Thailand to find his "billionaire grandfather" who is out of contact due to debt problems, but unexpectedly find the one who has been corresponding with his grandmother for years is not her husband.

titles.title: DELIVERY BOY
titles.synopsis: A young food delivery rider, who dreams of becoming a police officer, is forced to steal money to save his critically injured mother. Months later, when he discovers that the same man has been falsely accused of murder, he risks everything to save the life he once unknowingly changed forever.

titles.title: Bol Bhavein Na Bol
titles.synopsis: A boy and girl meet by chance. Their quiet connection grows into love as they learn the most profound feelings need no words. Grounded in innocence, hope, and life's simple beauty, it honors love that's felt beyond expression.

titles.title: Dhurandhar: The Fall
titles.synopsis: After a major accident leaves him injured and confined to his home for months, a young guy named Dipansh is forced to face pain, isolation, and uncertainty.  With little support around him, he begins navigating his recovery largely on his own, while confronting the unexpected actions of those he once called friends.  What begins as a physical fall slowly becomes a much deeper battle within.  A documentary short film by himself.

titles.title: Yen Ennai Edho Seidhai
titles.synopsis: Broken young man trapped in emotional darkness finds unexpected healing when Madhu's love guides him from self destruction toward hope, purpose, and light.

titles.title: Dhamaal 4
titles.synopsis: The Dhamaal boys are back for another treasure hunt, facing hilarious challenges in their quest for the Treasure of Life.

titles.title: Earle Meets World
titles.synopsis: Alix Earle, Gen Z's ultimate "It" girl, gets real in this unscripted, unfiltered series that goes behind the scenes of her life and family.

titles.title: G.D.N.
titles.synopsis: Based on the life of G.D. Naidu, the 'Edison of India', dramatising his groundbreaking innovations, his industrial contributions, and conflicts with authorities—including struggles where his work and international dealings faced severe scrutiny and opposition.

titles.title: Korean Kanakaraju
titles.synopsis: Follows a Rayalaseema youth named Kanakaraju whose life upends when a vessel from Korea brings a spirit that possesses him, transforming him into Korean Kanakaraju.

titles.title: A Minecraft Movie
titles.synopsis: Four misfits find themselves struggling with ordinary problems when they are suddenly pulled through a mysterious portal into the Overworld: a bizarre, cubic wonderland that thrives on imagination. To get back home, they'll have to master this world while embarking on a magical quest with an unexpected, expert crafter, Steve.

titles.title: Teenage Wasteland
titles.synopsis: Inspired by an unconventional teacher, a group of teenagers in upstate New York in the early 1990s make a student film and uncover a vast conspiracy that is poisoning their community. Thirty years later, they revisit their film and confront the legacy of this transformative experience.

titles.title: Jagamae Sangeetham
titles.synopsis: Set in Vaikuntapuram, a sacred temple town nestled between the banks of the Godavari and the neon lights of pop stardom, a disciplined heir to a musical throne and a fame-weary singer strike a forbidden chord. To protect a century of heritage, they must navigate a landscape of family secrets, masked identities, and the heavy price of finding their own voices.

titles.title: Parasomnia
titles.synopsis: After her friend vanishes, Riley must confront the demon from her night terrors that may have crossed into reality, while facing her own tragic past.

titles.title: Unmadham
titles.synopsis: A police constable reopens a long-forgotten case and experiences an unsettling world.

titles.title: The Grand Tour
titles.synopsis: Welcome to The Grand Tour. The world's greatest motoring show reboots with new presenters - Thomas Holland, James Engelsman and Francis Bourgeois - and its trademark blend of global adventure, incredible vehicles, epic stunts and strong opinions.

titles.title: Jeevan Bheema Yojana
titles.synopsis: Jeevan and Yojna are a couple drowning in debt who hatch an insurance scheme after crossing paths with Bheema, a stranger who bears a striking resemblance to Jeevan - but things spiral out of control when he turns out to be tangled up in a diamond smuggling racket.

titles.title: Mahaprabhu Jagannath
titles.synopsis: Lord Jagannath, a form of Hindu God Vishnu venerated across Odisha and widely worshipped throughout India, is the presiding deity of the 12th-century Puri temple and the subject of the annual Rath Yatra chariot festival, one of the country’s largest religious gatherings.

titles.title: Mirzapur: The Movie
titles.synopsis: The battle for Mirzapur’s throne intensifies as old enemies resurface and a new threat emerges in the form of Babban Babua, a ruthless businessman from Jaisalmer with ambitions of his own. As the Tripathis face enemies from both the past and present, loyalties are tested while Guddu and Bablu Pandit fight to establish themselves in the power struggle for Mirzapur.

titles.title: Mayday
titles.synopsis: When a U.S. Navy pilot on a top-secret mission during the Cold War gets trapped behind enemy lines, his only chance at survival is to form an alliance with an eccentric ex-KGB agent.

titles.title: I'm Game
titles.synopsis: A fearless gambler who trusts luck more than life gets caught in a series of crazy and unexpected events that turn his world upside down.

titles.title: Gandhari
titles.synopsis: When a mother loses her eyesight and her daughter in a kidnapping, she takes matters into her own hands to hunt down those responsible.

titles.title: The Runner
titles.synopsis: Maia Marten, a brilliant London lawyer, has her life shattered by a single call on her morning run: her son has been taken. To get him back, she must keep running, obey every ruthless command, and trust no one-each second a test of how far a mother will go to save her child.

titles.title: Clash of the Thundermans
titles.synopsis: When Chloe develops a destructive new superpower, the Hero League orders her to an elite boarding school for superheroes to learn control of her abilities. Faced with the prospect of sending Chloe away for years, the Thundermans split apart, with Phoebe, Barb and Billy taking her into hiding. Max, Hank, and Nora track their rogue family members, until the two factions face off against each other in a full-on battle for the Thundermans’ future.

titles.title: Romanchakam
titles.synopsis: A cocky engineering grad starts a dating app to prove he can succeed at anything. But a mysterious online connection turns his world upside down. Between a failed startup, money trouble, and crazy moments with his friends, things get messy when a strange encounter hints at something darker. What starts as a desperate chase for a girl becomes a tough journey inward--where he learns the hardest person to understand isn't someone else, but himself.

titles.title: Fito Páez: The World Within a Song
titles.synopsis: A documentary film that observes, listens to, and interacts with Fito Páez from a place of profound intimacy. The camera, almost invisible, witnesses his every move, accompanying him for over a year during recordings, rehearsals, tours, and performances in major cities across Latin America, Europe, and the United States. It is also a journey through the life of one of the greatest Spanish-language artists: his loves and heartbreaks, children and friendships, excesses, tragedies, failures, and successes.

titles.title: Fall 2: Deadpoint
titles.synopsis: On a perilous climb across Thailand's Mount Kwan, two climbers become trapped thousands of feet above the ground, where vertigo-inducing heights, sheer exposure, and impossible odds turn every moment into a fight for survival.

titles.title: Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris
titles.synopsis: Capturing Katy Perry’s electrifying, immersive concert experience, Katy Perry: The Lifetimes Tour – Live from Paris blends powerhouse performances, exhilarating cinematography, and intimate moments to bring audiences into the spectacular world of this creative artist.

titles.title: LEGO Star Wars: The Mandalorian
titles.synopsis: The Mandalorian and Grogu join their misfit allies for an epic party, celebrating their heroism. As friends regale the crowd with tales of their adventures, a pirate threat looms.

titles.title: Turning Point: Generation 9/11
titles.synopsis: A quarter-century after September 11th, the attacks' ripple effects persist across generations. Orphaned children, War on Terror journalists, young Afghans, and U.S. Marines shaped by the 2021 withdrawal share their stories.

titles.title: Lovesick
titles.synopsis: Set during the Mexican Revolution, follow Emilia Sauri, a woman torn between two passionate loves while navigating a world dominated by violence and revolution.

titles.title: Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu Official Podcast
titles.synopsis: Stream the official podcast for Star Wars: The Mandalorian and Grogu

titles.title: Kalari Kid – She Hits Back
titles.synopsis: In a society marked by gendered violence, nine-year-old Arushi and Milena, twenty-one, reclaim space through Kalari—the world’s oldest martial art. The film follows their fight for self-empowerment and the freedom to be the women they chose to be.

titles.title: Last Reckoning
titles.synopsis: Despite his best efforts to stay away from crime while he's out on parole, Dan's life takes a turn when a duffel bag full of cash meant for gangsters is mistakenly placed in his trunk. With the help of his eccentric friend, he has to choose whether to return the money to keep his family and friends safe, or to run and save himself.

titles.title: Untold: Raygun: Breaking Badly
titles.synopsis: Nobody, least of all Rachael Gunn, expected to be an Olympian. But as Raygun’s performance at the 2024 Paris Olympics went viral overnight, so did an avalanche of memes, misinformation, and conspiracy theories questioning how she ever got there.

titles.title: Jared Freid: The Family Plan
titles.synopsis: The special finds Freid keeping his issues “in the family,” joking about everything from vacationing with his parents to a Karen video that hits close to home.

titles.title: 9/11: United We Stand -- 25 Years Later
titles.synopsis: Explore how sports, music, Broadway and comedy helped Americans rediscover joy and begin to heal in the wake of the 9/11 attacks.

titles.title: The Varnell Hill Show
titles.synopsis: Follow Varnell Hill as he fights to stay relevant in a rapidly changing entertainment landscape. Between network executives eager to modernize the show, a chaotic writers' room, celebrity guests, family drama, and his own outsized ego, Varnell quickly discovers that keeping a television empire together may be harder than building one in the first place.

titles.title: Welcome to the Family: The Murder of Dan Markel
titles.synopsis: How far would you go for your family? The brutal murder of a prominent law professor in Tallahassee, Florida reveals the dark secrets of a wealthy family. A series of larger-than-life suspects leads to a mind-bending story of a murder-for-hire-plot, a messy custody battle, ex-lovers – and family dentistry. With exclusive access to those at the center of this extraordinary story, many of whom have never spoken before, this is the definitive telling of a case which took 11 years to solve.

titles.title: The Last Blossom
titles.synopsis: An elderly inmate serving a life sentence awaits a lonely death in solitary—until a voice calls out to him. It belongs to a balsam flower, Housenka, that speaks like a human. Through their 'conversation', the old man reflects on the life he's led.

titles.title: NXT Heatwave 2026
titles.synopsis: The 2026 NXT Heatwave was a professional wrestling television special and livestreaming event produced by WWE. It was the fifth annual Heatwave produced by WWE for its developmental brand NXT and the 12th Heatwave overall. The event took place on Sunday, August 30, 2026, at Bert Ogden Arena in Edinburg, Texas, United States - right after Lucha Libre AAA Worldwide's Ola de Calor event in the same venue.

titles.title: Plonternish
titles.synopsis: Eli writes a play.

titles.title: Four Hands, Two Sonatas
titles.synopsis: When two young pianists from completely different worlds meet at an elite music high school, the melodies of their lives become intimately intertwined.

titles.title: The Salt Path
titles.synopsis: The profound story of husband and wife Raynor and Moth Winn, who embark on a 630-mile trek after being forcibly removed from their home. Hoping that in nature they will find solace and a sense of acceptance, they walk through the beautiful but rugged coastlines of South West England - a journey that is exhilarating, challenging, and liberating in equal measure. THE SALT PATH is a powerful portrayal of home, and how it can be lost and rediscovered in the most unexpected ways.

titles.title: Coyote vs. Acme
titles.synopsis: After Acme products fail him one too many times in his dogged pursuit of the Roadrunner, Wile E. Coyote decides to hire a billboard lawyer to sue the Acme Corporation.

titles.title: Hi!
titles.synopsis: Two individuals initially exchange a simple "Hi," but through a series of chance encounters, shared experiences, and deep conversations, they gradually develop a strong connection and eventually fall in love.

titles.title: Once More
titles.synopsis: Raghu, a man caught up with a deep hold of grief comes across Anjali, who is spinning everything in her capacity to win him over. The love you gave away always comes back they say. In one way or other. Sometimes from a different human. This is a story of love coming back into the life of someone who doesn’t want to take it. A tale of second chances.. happy healing and bitter sweet closures.

titles.title: Finding Emily
titles.synopsis: When a lovesick musician is given the wrong number for his dream girl, he teams up with a driven psychology student to find her. Together, they spark a hilarious campus-wide frenzy that tests their own hearts and ambitions along the way.

titles.title: Your's Sincerely RAAM
titles.synopsis: Upcoming Kannada Film

titles.title: Maya Satya Bhram
titles.synopsis: Two disappearances unsettle Kolkata’s Prafulla Nagar: Totoro, the young son of Sub-Inspector Sanjay Konar, and Sara, a Swedish researcher studying shamans. Their fates intertwine around one enigmatic man, Trilokeshwar Baba. Once known as Tilu, a boy haunted by violence and visions of death, Trilok grows into a mystic who seems to perceive the boundaries between the living and the beyond. As Sanjay’s search unfolds, the line between truth and faith begins to dissolve.

titles.title: Colony
titles.synopsis: Professor Se-jeong is thrust into a bloody nightmare when a rapidly mutating virus is released during a biotech conference causing authorities to seal the facility. Trapped inside with no escape, Se-jeong along with a small group of survivors must fight to stay alive while the infected undergo horrific transformations.

titles.title: The Dog Stars
titles.synopsis: After the world's population has been ravaged by a pandemic, a man lives a lonesome existence in a Colorado airplane hangar with his dog and a dour gunman he has befriended. When a mysterious transmission comes through on the radio while he’s flying his old Cessna, it sparks a hunt for the provenance of the sound.

titles.title: Filipiñana
titles.synopsis: Amid stifling heat, Isabel, a 17-year-old Ilocana, works at a posh country club outside Manila. New to the job, she wanders its immaculate grounds, sampling its luxuries. But beneath the pristine fairways, something is rotting. When Isabel tries to return a mislaid golf club to the club’s president, Dr. Palanca, she discovers the violent truths of her workplace, her country, and her own past.

titles.title: Barreda
titles.synopsis: A fictionalized drama film based on one of the most shocking crimes in Argentina's history. In 1992, Ricardo Barreda was an unassuming dentist, brutally murdered his wife, mother-in-law, and two adult daughters in their family home. Branding himself as a victim, Ricardo Barreda ignited a media storm and fueled a national scandal.

titles.title: Beyond Belief
titles.synopsis: An aspiring teenage rock star trains for a marathon after hearing a mysterious voice.

titles.title: Just Play Dead
titles.synopsis: A criminal mastermind plans to fake his death for insurance money while framing his wife's lover. His wife plots to kill him for real and take it all. Both race to outmanoeuvre each other in a deadly battle of wits.

titles.title: The Sun Never Sets
titles.synopsis: Wendy’s life is thrown into chaos when her boyfriend, Jack, who is older and divorced with children, insists they take space to evaluate the relationship. During their break, Wendy runs into her ex, Chuck, forcing them into a volatile triangle.

titles.title: Buddy
titles.synopsis: A magical, singing orange unicorn holds his cast hostage in a surreal TV-show dimension, as he becomes more and more demented.

titles.title: The Last Scene
titles.synopsis: Selen is a woman with the extraordinary ability to foresee other people’s futures in her dreams. Determined to use this gift to change her own life and the fate of those around her, she unexpectedly finds herself drawn into a dangerous love story. When she crosses paths with Kemal, their connection sparks both passion and peril, forcing Selen to make choices that will shape both of their destinies.

titles.title: The Secret Woman
titles.synopsis: After discovering she has a family and a shipping empire, a woman with amnesia returns to a wealthy and seemingly perfect past to uncover why she left.

titles.title: Baggo
titles.synopsis: Directed by Baljit Singh Deo

titles.title: Kiku Chiranjeevi
titles.synopsis: A young man named Chiru, born with dextrocardia-a rare condition where his heart is on the right side of his chest faces struggles and challenges as he works to overcome his condition and achieve his goals.

titles.title: Tom & Cherry
titles.synopsis: When Tom suddenly disappears, a mysterious man named Cheer becomes part of an extraordinary journey that no one sees coming. Packed with laughter, emotions, unexpected twists, and heartwarming moments, Tom and Cherry is a wholesome family entertainer that celebrates the true meaning of love and togetherness.

titles.title: Idiots
titles.synopsis: When two unqualified bozos are hired to transfer a rich teen to rehab, their straightforward gig quickly spirals into dangerous mayhem.

titles.title: Legend of the White Dragon
titles.synopsis: Forced to hide in the shadows, fugitive hero Erik Reed must clear his name to reunite with his family. Standing in his way is a mysterious villain obsessed with destroying the White Dragon for good.

titles.title: The Producer
titles.synopsis: A reckless young graduate becomes the assistant to a demanding music producer, and their clashes turn into an unlikely partnership as they take on the music industry's biggest challenges.

titles.title: Mousetrap
titles.synopsis: A reclusive writer wakes to find his identity stolen — and must ally with a ruthless loan shark to reclaim his life from a man known as "The Rat."

titles.title: All the Truth in My Lies
titles.synopsis: Two roommates join a bachelorette road trip, where unspoken feelings ignite and shake up their entire friend group.

titles.title: Gang War Oslo
titles.synopsis: An inside look at Norway's criminal landscape since the 1980s -- as told by those who ruled the streets and lived to share their stories.

titles.title: God Is Shy
titles.synopsis: During a train ride, Ariel and Paul pass the time sketching their deepest fears. Their game takes an unexpected turn when Gilda, a mysterious passenger, intrudes on their exchange. Yet, her relationship with fear seems far less innocent than their playful drawings.

titles.title: The Whisper Man
titles.synopsis: When his young son vanishes, a widower enlists help from his estranged father, a retired detective who put away the serial killer now linked to the case.

titles.title: Dalliance
titles.synopsis: Billy, a former cameraman, encounters Dani on a Sydney Harbour ferry as their different worlds intersect.

titles.title: Countdown to Avengers: Doomsday Official Podcast
titles.synopsis: Iman Vellani and Frank Alvarez host a rewatch of films from Marvel Studios' The Infinity Saga, working their way to Avengers: Doomsday. Together, they revisit each film with a recap and a conversation about which themes and characters may continue to have future implications.

titles.title: Toxic: A Fairy Tale for Grown-ups
titles.synopsis: A powerful drug cartel pulls the strings behind a facade of sun-soaked beaches as a gritty, violent underworld power struggle emerges during the crumbling of Portuguese colonial rule.

titles.title: The Last Sunrise
titles.synopsis: Ry, a college student with a chronic illness, escapes to Mallorca for the summer with her mother, where she unexpectedly falls for a local and begins to embrace living in the moment. But as her condition worsens and long-hidden family secrets come to light, everything she has found before summer's end is threatened.

titles.title: 2 Big to Rig
titles.synopsis: Captured live over the course of GHOST’s two sold-out shows in Mexico City last year, 2 BIG TO RIG is the definitive document of the band's unforgettable SKELETOUR WORLD TOUR, presented in IMAX® in select locations.  Featuring the only pro-shot footage of Papa V Perpetua and his band of Nameless Ghouls from the phone-free SKELETOUR, 2 BIG TO RIG immerses the audience in the GHOST live ritual, including exclusive behind-the-scenes and backstage access.

titles.title: Yellow Mirror
titles.synopsis: A defective lamp reveals a heartbreaking truth about what Homer believes is reality, and an AI-powered tablet befriends and controls Maggie. The Simpsons struggle to find the light through two dark tales of the curious and bizarre.

titles.title: The Last Salute
titles.synopsis: Chronicles the MiG-21's final chapter in the Indian Air Force, showcasing stories of generations of fighter pilots who flew it.

titles.title: Dolly: An NBC News Special
titles.synopsis: A look back at Dolly Parton's remarkable journey to stardom, her groundbreaking career and her lasting impact far beyond music.

titles.title: My Name Is Gutierrez
titles.synopsis: Deputy Commissioner Gutierrez competes with the CIA to solve the murder of the Russian Ambassador with his unique style.

titles.title: The Early Spring
titles.synopsis: New to Beijing, Shang Zhitao crosses paths with Luan Nian, a true creative genius. Bold and open-hearted, she grows stronger step by step and gradually breaks through the defenses around Luan's guarded heart. Drawn to each other, they find themselves caught in an intense, on-again, off-again relationship in the urban jungle. To love is to summon all your courage and leave no regrets, to heal each other, and to grow together. But when love and her career pull her in different directions, she puts her career first. When she has come into her own and he has learned to soften his sharp edges, they finally stand as equals, ready to write a new ending together...

titles.title: The Airport Chaplain
titles.synopsis: Airport Chaplain Tobias Wallace is convinced the airport couldn’t possibly run without his 24/7 devotion. But new Terminal Manager Mira Ansari-Cole is convinced he’s a walking liability.

titles.title: Totally '90s House
titles.synopsis: Follows two teams of '90s television idols with a passion for design and renovation as they scour the country for houses stuck in the 1990s - think honey oak cabinets, sponge-painted walls and mirrored closets - with each team ultimately picking their perfect throwback in need of a major overhaul.

titles.title: Wishbone Kitchen
titles.synopsis: Pull up a kitchen stool and press play. Each week, Meredith Hayden — the voice behind Wishbone Kitchen — sits down to talk cozy, crave-worthy recipes, real kitchen tips, and the small rituals that turn a house into a home. It's the kind of podcast that makes you want to light a candle, pour a glass of wine, and press record on your own kitchen story.

titles.title: Death of the Pastor's Wife
titles.synopsis: What happened to Mica Miller? This documentary series retraces her promising life, toxic marriage and the mysterious circumstances of her death.

titles.title: Mom Knows Best?
titles.synopsis: Nine mothers compete to prove they know their children best; they wager money on predicting their children's choices and discover that their children can still surprise them.

titles.title: Untold: The Testimony of Vince Young
titles.synopsis: After delivering one of the greatest performances in Rose Bowl history, Texas Longhorns legend Vince Young was the NFL's next big thing, and for a while, he was. But a career riddled by injuries, conflict and sudden loss tells a far more complicated story than the highlight reels ever showed.

titles.title: Stamptown
titles.synopsis: Blending the wild worlds of circus and comedy, anarchic acts collide for this raunchy and explicit variety show - clothing not guaranteed.

titles.title: Dolly Parton: An American Original – Special Edition of 20/20
titles.synopsis: Celebrating Dolly Parton's life, music and legacy -- featuring never-before-seen interviews with Dolly herself, unforgettable interviews with Robin Roberts and Barbara Walters, and reflections from those who knew her best.

titles.title: Spark
titles.synopsis: An investigative journalist takes on a massive bank scam, challenging a powerful cop—and soon uncovers a deadly conspiracy that leads straight to its hidden mastermind.

titles.title: Anchorage Point
titles.synopsis: World renown architect struggles with the weight of his failed bridge design and the lives it claimed

titles.title: Oozhi
titles.synopsis: After two years apart, Lenin and Megha unexpectedly meet at a stargazing camp. When Lenin discovers an alien stone that takes him back into the memories and guilt of their past, he sees a chance to fix what he broke.

titles.title: The Marching Band
titles.synopsis: A world-famous orchestra conductor discovers the brother he never knew he had — a school cafeteria worker who plays trombone in a local marching band. Detecting his brother's exceptional musical talent, he takes it upon himself to rectify the injustice of fate.

titles.title: The Magic Faraway Tree
titles.synopsis: A modern family relocates to the countryside where the children discover a magical tree with eccentric residents. They're transported to fantastical lands, rekindling their family bond through adventures.

titles.title: Colours of Time
titles.synopsis: When four distant cousins inherit a 19th-century home in Normandy, they decide to visit and examine their family history. No one has lived there since the 1940s, and the cousins are intrigued by all of the items they find there, little things that help them to understand their ancestor, Adèle Vermillard. Jumping back and forth in time, they meet the mysterious Adèle, whose bohemian lifestyle, and her relationships with the leading artists of the time, changes their lives.

titles.title: Late Fame
titles.synopsis: Legendary New York poet Ed Saxberger's forgotten works captivate an eccentric group of young creatives, reigniting his artistic passion. Their intrigue intertwines with the bewitching presence of actress Gloria.

titles.title: Mutiny
titles.synopsis: After witnessing his billionaire boss' murder and being framed for the crime, Cole Reed boards a cargo ship on a one-man crusade to avenge his boss' death only to discover an international conspiracy.

titles.title: Insidious: Out of the Further
titles.synopsis: Gemma, a young mother raising her daughter in the house she grew up in, discovers she can travel into The Further, where she possesses an ability to bring what lives there back to the real world.

titles.title: OK! Madam: Bon Voyage
titles.synopsis: Six years after the Hawaii airplane hijacking, Mi-yeong finds herself struggling with her rebellious teenage daughter, Nari, and her unemployed husband, Seok-hwan. When Hyun-min, a flight attendant she met during the hijacking, invites her family to his wedding aboard a luxury cruise ship, Mi-yeong eagerly proposes a family holiday. Met with indifference from her husband and daughter, she decides to embark alone, joining Hyun-min's family and Ji-hoon, a charming magician. However, on the eve of the wedding, the celebration turns deadly when armed assailants seize the ship. After Seok-hwan and Nari are kidnapped and brought aboard, Mi-yeong discovers that she is the target of a much larger plot.

titles.title: 7 Dogs
titles.synopsis: Interpol agent Khalid Al-Azzazi joins forces with Ghali Abu Dawood from the 7 Dogs crime syndicate to fight drug trafficking.

titles.title: Tony
titles.synopsis: A 19-year-old Anthony Bourdain travels to Provincetown and stumbles into the chaotic world of a restaurant kitchen, setting off a summer that will shape the course of his life.

titles.title: Spa Weekend
titles.synopsis: Four lifelong friends realize that somewhere between careers, relationships, families, and everyday responsibilities, they’ve forgotten how to take care of themselves and each other. Burned out and overdue for a break, the women escape to a luxury spa retreat for an unforgettable weekend dedicated to fun, laughter, and a lot of really bad decisions.

titles.title: It Ends
titles.synopsis: A group of recent grads head out on a late night drive for grub, hoping to enjoy one final hangout before their paths diverge. Instead, they accidentally turn onto a never-ending, two-lane hellscape surrounded by untold horrors and cosmic forces beyond their understanding. Cramped together inside a Jeep Cherokee and with the miles stretching infinitely ahead, they face a choice: embrace their new existence or fight to escape it.

titles.title: Irumudi
titles.synopsis: An alcoholic with a violent past—living peacefully with his daughter beside a waterfall—decides to take Ayyappa Deeksha (a 41-day spiritual vow and period of intense austerity) at her request.

titles.title: All That We Never Were
titles.synopsis: 19-year-old Leah navigates a coming-of-age journey in the wake of a tragic car accident that claims her parents. Relocated to a coastal town under the care of her brother’s best friend Axel, Leah grapples with grief, haunting nightmares and a fractured sense of self.

titles.title: Bethlehem Kudumba Unit
titles.synopsis: Ashley's homecoming from abroad takes an emotional turn when a wedding next door stirs memories of her first love, Justin.

titles.title: How to Divorce During the War
titles.synopsis: Vilnius 2022. High-flying executive Marija chooses the worst possible moment for an honest conversation with her husband Vytas about divorcing - just one day before Russia’s invasion of Ukraine goes into full scale. Now they must navigate the process of separation as it collides with a refugee and mid-life crisis.

titles.title: Pyaar Prema Kalyanam
titles.synopsis: When a bride refuses to leave her family home after marriage, her husband must find out if he can adjust to life under his in-laws' roof.

titles.title: Ram and Leela
titles.synopsis: The story revolves around a 30-year-old man whose family is searching for a suitable bride For his marriage. At the same time, he is also hoping to find true love, but nothing works out. Eventually, he meets a young woman named Leela, they fall in love, face several Unexpected challenges and twists, and finally overcome them to unite

titles.title: Facing El Chapo
titles.synopsis: Two Mexican officers must survive the final hours of their shift after crossing a ruthless cartel boss.

titles.title: Kadhal Aura
titles.synopsis: Two men with opposite beliefs about love and God are cursed to swap souls, forcing them to live each other's lives and face the women they love.

titles.title: Judaa
titles.synopsis: A young man sacrifices his chance at love to preserve a cherished friendship. When loss reshapes their lives, he carries forward an unfulfilled dream of universal education, keeping alive the memory of the woman who inspired it.

titles.title: Modha Rathri
titles.synopsis: Two strangers are brought together at an unusual wedding where, in one night, too many surprises unfold and several lies are told, spiraling into chaos that changes everything.

titles.title: LEGO Disney Princess: Magical Mayhem
titles.synopsis: During a heavy rainstorm, the Princess characters and their sidekick friends take in animals in need while enjoying a cozy day in their castle. But when the animals run amok, chaos erupts. Sleuthing reveals a mischievous villain behind it all, and with teamwork, quick thinking, and help from an unexpected friend, the Princess characters must restore order and save their home.

titles.title: Harrd Disk
titles.synopsis: Entrusted with a hard disk believed to hold information that could topple ministers, a young boy gets caught in a deadly game between a cop and a political fixer. Everybody wants it. No one knows what's inside.

titles.title: Ameer Log
titles.synopsis: Three carefree friends from a bustling Hyderabad basti spend their days wandering narrow lanes, sharing plates of biryani, and dreaming of a better life. When an old cook's secret recipe brings unexpected success their way, they must choose between fleeting fame and the enduring value of friendship, memories, and the taste of home.

titles.title: The Red Bag
titles.synopsis: Four women trapped in a deadly human-trafficking empire steal a mysterious red bag and race through betrayal, violence, and relentless pursuit, only to discover the bag holds a secret powerful enough to change everything.

titles.title: Bardaasht
titles.synopsis: After being falsely imprisoned, Karma returns to his village determined to take revenge on the man who destroyed his family.

titles.title: Hot Spot
titles.synopsis: Set in a near future society ruled by sentient A.I., a private eye investigates a murder case only to discover a rebel group capable of undermining the digital overlord. As the detective's identity slowly unravels, his world enters a state of hypnotic meltdown.

titles.title: 9/11: Reunited
titles.synopsis: The story of September 11 through the eyes of survivors who experienced life-or-death moments with strangers that day and now want to meet again.

titles.title: The Girls: A Khloé Kardashian Project
titles.synopsis: They're building empires. They're building families. They're always unfiltered. Welcome to The Girls, where Khloé Kardashian's inner circle of real-life besties are raising babies, running businesses, and surviving brutally honest group chats. From surprise proposals to solo parenting, glam getaways to growing pains, this is the new era of reality TV where the chaos is couture — and the bonds are unbreakable.

titles.title: Khalifa: The Ruler
titles.synopsis: Aamir Ali, a notorious gold smuggling kingpin who inherited his multi-million dollar criminal enterprise from a lineage of gangsters, is drawn into a web of vengeance, legacy and power.

titles.title: He Loves Me Not
titles.synopsis: An aspiring actress chosen as a wild card for a reality TV dating show uses a secret elixir to win the heart of the star, but when her deception is revealed, she discovers a messy but real chance for love.

titles.title: Novak Djokovic: The Wolf in Winter
titles.synopsis: He's conquered every title in tennis, including an Olympic gold. So why is Novak Djokovic still playing? The Wolf in Winter embeds with the greatest tennis player of all time as he returned to the Australian Open in 2025, capturing the obsession, the preparation, and the fire that won't go out even when there's nothing left to prove.

titles.title: Chompoo: Lost​ &​ Forgotten​
titles.synopsis: When a young girl vanishes from a remote village, the frantic police hunt become a media frenzy. But who turned a suspected criminal into a celebrity?

titles.title: Kudiyan Shehar Diyan
titles.synopsis: Three ambitious women leave their small towns for the city, chasing successful careers while facing tough choices that threaten their relationships, values, and identities.

titles.title: The Dynasty: UConn Huskies
titles.synopsis: Go inside the most dominant program in college basketball history as Geno Auriemma pushes his players to the limit to win 12 titles. Rebecca Lobo, Diana Taurasi, Paige Bueckers, and more reveal what it takes to survive UConn and build a dynasty.

titles.title: Blood Sacrifice
titles.synopsis: Following the brutal murder of two police officers, a tenacious detective reluctantly joins forces with his estranged ex-cop father to catch the killer.

titles.title: S&X
titles.synopsis: At his clinic, sex therapist Ichito Shimotori treats diverse and intimate sexual issues with sincerity. Yet, he secretly hides a struggle of his own.

titles.title: Outer Banks: The Official Podcast
titles.synopsis: Host Ria Ciuffo sits down with Outer Banks stars Chase Stokes, Madelyn Cline, Carlacia Grant, Jonathan Daviss, and Madison Bailey to celebrate the series' five-season run.

titles.title: Abijit Ganguly: Baby
titles.synopsis: Stand-up special

titles.title: Lion
titles.synopsis: The extraordinary true story of lion cub Kio, on his journey to become a king.

titles.title: A Beautiful Obsession
titles.synopsis: An intimate, raw portrait of Manchester City FC across two era-defining seasons. With unprecedented access, the film follows their worst run in decades and fightback to glory.

titles.title: Back to the 90s
titles.synopsis: When a mysterious glitch sends a rising boyband back to 1995 - just days before the biggest showcase of their lives - the five friends race to reverse the time slip. But as unexpected connections form and the past pulls them in deeper, getting home means confronting what they're willing to leave behind - and who they truly are to each other.

titles.title: Kelsey Cook: Happy Hour
titles.synopsis: In this candid and clever stand-up special, Kelsey Cook explores "hangxiety," relives a plane bathroom nightmare and breaks down dating a literal Chad.

titles.title: Sapan Verma: Lower Back Pain
titles.synopsis: Stand-up comedy special by Span Verma

titles.title: Insecta
titles.synopsis: A celebrated horror novelist returns to an isolated estate to say goodbye to her dying father, only to discover that the monstrous imaginary insect that tormented her childhood may have been real all along.

titles.title: Take a Hike!
titles.synopsis: Four celebrity hiking newbies end up forming a club to tackle Korea's snow‑capped peaks. Can they figure out why on earth people go to the mountains?

titles.title: Cradle of Coaches
titles.synopsis: This documentary delves into the history of remarkable leaders, their groundbreaking achievements, and the profound connections that have shaped football’s greatest coaching legacy.

titles.title: World's Most Evil Women
titles.synopsis: World's Most Evil Women unmasks those who traded compassion for cruelty, committing acts so horrific they shattered entire communities.

titles.title: Disney Worldbuilders
titles.synopsis: We sit down with some of the key figures shaping Disney’s most enduring stories for a series of intimate conversations about their early years, first sparks, and formative Disney memories — and how the worlds they once dreamed up are now taking shape at Disney destinations around the globe.

titles.title: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration
titles.synopsis: Disney Princess: The Ultimate Concert Celebration at Disneyland Resort brings together the largest gathering of Disney Princess stars ever assembled, celebrating the iconic stories across animation, live-action, stage, and music. This one-of-a-kind concert will transform the night skies with dazzling lights, sweeping projections, and sky-high fountains creating a truly immersive world where the music, magic, and legacy of Disney Princesses shine like never before.

titles.title: Wolfsbane
titles.synopsis: Combe Noire forest, French Alps. The daughter of a troubled man comes to gather his things, 6 months after her father went missing. She soon realizes that something unnatural is happening in Combe Noire, and that Mother Earth might be sending her hounds onto us.

titles.title: Bigg Boss The Common Man
titles.synopsis: From ordinary lives to extraordinary drama. Aspiring contestants fight to earn a spot in the Bigg Boss house.

titles.title: Lanterns
titles.synopsis: Two intergalactic cops, new recruit John Stewart and Lantern legend Hal Jordan, are drawn into a dark, Earth-based mystery as they investigate a murder in the American heartland.

titles.title: Hushar Pittalu
titles.synopsis: In a village, two teenagers, Ravi and Chitti, are drawn into a secret relationship as curiosity, adolescence, and bad influences shape their choices. When their families discover the affair, the couple defies them, setting off a chain of events that reveals how parental mistakes, peer pressure, and youthful attraction can alter young lives forever.

titles.title: 108 Base Hospital Uri
titles.synopsis: Resilient army doctors at 108 Base Hospital, Uri, navigate personal and professional battles whilst saving lives in a conflict-torn zone.

titles.title: Bigg Boss: Agnipareeksha
titles.synopsis: The journey to Bigg Boss Malayalam 8 begins in Agnipareeksha, where commoner contestants battle for a place in the Bigg Boss House.

titles.title: The End of Oak Street
titles.synopsis: After a mysterious cosmic event rips Oak Street from suburbia and transports their neighborhood to someplace unknown, the Platt family soon discovers that their very survival depends on them sticking together as they navigate their now unrecognizable surroundings.

titles.title: The Rivals of Amziah King
titles.synopsis: Deep within the backwoods of rural Oklahoma, charismatic and musically gifted Amziah King herds a bluegrass-playing band of misfits while overseeing the premier honey-making operation in town. When Amziah’s estranged foster daughter unexpectedly returns, Amziah leaps at the possibility to renew connection and create a family business. But the honey game is ruthless, and Amziah’s rivals threaten to destroy everything he has built.

titles.title: PAW Patrol: The Dino Movie
titles.synopsis: The Paw Patrol lands on a mysterious dinosaur island after a storm, where they meet Rex, a stranded pup. When Humdinger's reckless mining triggers a volcano, the team faces their biggest rescue mission yet to save the island.

titles.title: The Wrong Girls
titles.synopsis: Two codependent best friends living paycheck to paycheck and bong rip to bong rip get caught in a case of mistaken identity that throws their lives into chaos.

titles.title: Teenage Sex and Death at Camp Miasma
titles.synopsis: After years of slapdash sequels and waning fandom, the Camp Miasma slasher franchise is handed over to an enthusiastic young director for resurrection. But when she visits the original's star, a now-reclusive actress shrouded in mystery, the two women fall into a blood-soaked world of desire, fear, and delirium.

titles.title: The Birthday Party
titles.synopsis: The late 1970s, somewhere in the Mediterranean: Marcos Timoleon, a tycoon, is throwing a lavish, extravagant birthday party for Sofia on his exclusive private island. The party is a perfect excuse for various people in his life to approach him with their own agendas.

titles.title: Vishwanath & Sons
titles.synopsis: Sanjay Vishwanath is an acclaimed professional handgunner in his 40s with a major stake in fame and wealth. When he comes across a woman named Maddy in her 20s, their dynamic poses many issues that they must come to terms with.

titles.title: Nimrods
titles.synopsis: Three friends journey from Kansas City to Los Angeles, mistakenly believing that their band is opening for Green Day on New Year’s Eve.

titles.title: Awarapan 2
titles.synopsis: Shivam returns to the crime world, where his path forward demands redemption, love, and sacrifice. As relationships deepen and conflicts intensify, every choice tests his resolve and shapes his destiny.

titles.title: Keu Bole Biplobi, Keu Bole Dakat
titles.synopsis: A biopic of Ananta Singha. Some calls him dacoit, some calls him a rebellion. This adaptation gives the viewer a chance to know him as a whole, a person and as a revolutionary communist leader.

titles.title: Whitmer Thomas: Terminal Crew of Dudes
titles.synopsis: Comedian, musician, and actor Whitmer Thomas digs into his small-town Alabama upbringing and his ongoing quest to be cool.

titles.title: Magudam
titles.synopsis: Peaceful medical representative and shipping harbor worker Linga's life changes because of betrayal and conflict in a coastal community.

titles.title: Madhuramee Jeevitham
titles.synopsis: Madhuramee Jeevitham is a poignant family drama that explores aging, relationships, and the quiet beauty of everyday life.

titles.title: My Best Friend, His Girlfriend and Me
titles.synopsis: Olli and Matze are best friends living, working and planning to travel the world together — until Matze's romance with Rebecca turns it all upside down.

titles.title: All Wishes Come True!
titles.synopsis: Eight grassroot mortals use their street smarts and hilarious schemes to defy powerful gods, earning their title as the Eight Immortals.

titles.title: Freefall: A Reckoning for Boeing
titles.synopsis: Following the highly publicized death of Boeing whistleblower John Barnett, the investigation continues into the once-iconic aviation giant, uncovering startling new revelations and insider accounts in the wake of a deepening corporate crisis..

titles.title: Elijah Peel
titles.synopsis: A stadium-filling rock star, Elijah Peel is at the top of the world … until his addiction leads to a heart attack that could cost him everything. During his recovery, Elijah encounters a remarkable young girl whose unwavering faith, radiant spirit, and wisdom beyond her years begin to break through the walls he has built around his heart. Her extraordinary hope and their unexpected bond inspire Elijah to begin a powerful journey toward healing, reconciliation, and faith.

titles.title: People & Things
titles.synopsis: A group of twenty-somethings navigate heartache, burnout and digital gloom as they search for meaning, connection and themselves in modern day Los Angeles.

titles.title: Sammarth
titles.synopsis: When an unexpected turn of events shatters a young civil engineer's life, he is forced to confront his past, his beliefs, and his destiny.

titles.title: Aali
titles.synopsis: Mulla (Aali), a sound engineer near the Tamil Nadu-Kerala border, falls for Ebby Mathew, an Ayurveda doctor working in Dubai. Facing family opposition and pressure to accept other matches, she plans to elope with him. Whether he returns in time, and whether their plan succeeds, forms the story's core.

titles.title: Pallaburusu
titles.synopsis: A 70 year old widower asks his son to buy him a toothbrush for his toothache. When the son fails to do this simple errand, their already strained father-son relationship becomes comically worse through a series of escalating events.

titles.title: The Brink of War
titles.synopsis: President Ronald Reagan races against time to salvage a deal with Soviet leader Mikhail Gorbachev that could dismantle nuclear arsenals—or ignite disaster. With pressure mounting on all sides, every word spoken brings the world closer to peace... or destruction.

titles.title: The Rotten Files with Stephanie Soo
titles.synopsis: Stephanie Soo dives deep into today's most explosive cases to uncover killers and predators who thought their stories would stay buried.

titles.title: The Sex Slave
titles.synopsis: A harrowing two-part documentary chronicling how a mother of five suddenly found herself being sold to unknown men... by her own partner.
